title: ui: fix lsp error in quality_score.rs
description: Correct the Result<VNode, RenderError> return type mismatch in the QualityScoreBar component.

ubiquitous: THE SYSTEM SHALL compile without LSP diagnostics.

event_driven.shall: THE SYSTEM SHALL return a valid Element.

unwanted.condition: IF the return type is unit ()
unwanted.shall_not: THE SYSTEM SHALL NOT allow the build to proceed
unwanted.because: Dioxus requires explicit return types for components.

preconditions: quality_score.rs has an active ERROR diagnostic
invariants: The component logic remains functionally correct

phase_0: Wrap return value in Ok() or rsx!

title: ui: standardize tailwind quality classes
description: Define shared utility functions for quality-based coloring (green/yellow/red) to ensure visual consistency.

ubiquitous: THE SYSTEM SHALL use a consistent color language for quality metrics.

event_driven.shall: THE SYSTEM SHALL apply the standardized tailwind classes.

unwanted.condition: IF an ad-hoc hex code is used
unwanted.shall_not: THE SYSTEM SHALL NOT pass UI review

invariants: Color thresholds match the 70% gate logic

phase_1: Move to a shared ui/theme.rs module

title: ui: implement effect graph visualizer
description: Visualize the dependency graph generated by the LatticeEngine using a Dioxus-compatible SVG renderer.

ubiquitous: THE SYSTEM SHALL provide a visual representation of requirement dependencies.

event_driven.trigger: WHEN the effect graph is opened
event_driven.shall: THE SYSTEM SHALL render the causal nodes and edges.

unwanted.shall_not: THE SYSTEM SHALL NOT crash the renderer

postconditions: SVG graph is rendered in the UI
invariants: Nodes represent Behaviors, Edges represent causal links

title: ui: add challenge ui for inversion
description: Create a UI section to display assumption challenges from the Inversion lattice. Allow users to refine requirements based on challenges.

ubiquitous: THE SYSTEM SHALL surface critical challenges to the user.

event_driven.trigger: WHEN an inversion challenge is generated
event_driven.shall: THE SYSTEM SHALL render it as an actionable card.

unwanted.shall_not: THE SYSTEM SHALL NOT clear the warning until addressed

invariants: Challenges are linked directly to the originating Answer

title: ui: standardize error boundaries
description: Implement Dioxus error boundaries using the unified ClarityError taxonomy to prevent full-page crashes.

ubiquitous: THE SYSTEM SHALL isolate component failures.

event_driven.shall: THE SYSTEM SHALL render a localized error card with diagnostic info.

unwanted.shall_not: THE SYSTEM SHALL NOT show a generic 'Something went wrong'

postconditions: ErrorBoundary component wraps major UI sections
invariants: Zero unhandled panics in the UI thread

phase_1: Apply boundaries to Discovery and Planning pages
